name: cognikit
description: A kit that gives AI agents cognitive abilities. Premium Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any SKILL.md-compatible platform.

bundles.name: full
bundles.description: Every skill in the kit, one install.

bundles.name: design
bundles.description: Visual direction, surface-specific design skills, and the architecture to keep it consistent.
bundles.install: npx skills add RimoraStudio/cognikit --skill design-systems --skill design-system-architecture --skill marketing-sites --skill dashboard-ui --skill mobile-app-design --global --yes

bundles.name: engineering
bundles.description: Contract design and review quality gates.
bundles.install: npx skills add RimoraStudio/cognikit --skill code-review --skill api-design --skill security-audit --skill skill-authoring --global --yes

bundles.name: ai-stack
bundles.description: Agent tooling, memory, retrieval, and local models.
bundles.install: npx skills add RimoraStudio/cognikit --skill mcp-server --skill agent-memory --skill model-distillation --skill rag-pipelines --global --yes

bundles.name: launch
bundles.description: Everything needed before shipping: security, SEO, legal docs, store compliance.
bundles.install: npx skills add RimoraStudio/cognikit --skill security-audit --skill seo --skill legal-docs --skill apple-app-store-compliance --skill google-play-compliance --global --yes

skills.name: design-systems
skills.description: Choose and implement the right visual design system for any app or website. Brief-inference read with variance/motion/density dials, 14 design systems with when-to-use guidance plus buy-vs-build routing, a variance engine for non-repeating directions, 122 anti-AI-slop rules, component patterns (double-bezel cards, gapless bento, magnetic hover, micro-UIs), AIDA page structure, audit-and-upgrade workflow, DESIGN.md spec generation, anti-drift conventions, and UX psychology laws with a dark-pattern guardrail.

skills.name: design-system-architecture
skills.description: Build, scale, audit, and govern a design system as an engineering product. Covers token architecture, governance models, contribution tiers, versioning, deprecation, drift detection, multi-brand orchestration, Figma-to-code pipelines, CI gates, and AI-agent readiness.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review code changes for real bugs, security issues, and convention violations with a confidence filter that suppresses noise. Covers correctness, security, state/concurrency, error handling, and project-convention violations, plus an optional simplicity pass that hunts over-engineering (reinvented stdlib, dead abstractions, unneeded deps) with one-liner findings. Severity-ranked findings with file:line citations, not style nitpicks.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Design REST API contracts before implementation: resource modeling, route conventions, request/response shapes, error codes, pagination, idempotency, and versioning. Produces consistent, predictable API contracts that respect existing codebase conventions.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Adversarial security review of a codebase. Maps attack surface, checks OWASP Top 10 in priority order (access control, injection, auth, crypto, misconfig, SSRF, XSS, secrets), audits dependency CVEs, and produces severity-ranked findings with exploitability confirmation and remediation. Defensive analysis only.

skills.name: mcp-server
skills.description: Design and build Model Context Protocol servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts to AI agents. Discovery-first design phase, deployment decision matrix (remote HTTP / MCP app / MCPB bundled / stdio), tool design patterns, elicitation vs widget routing, .mcp.json plugin integration, MCPB manifest and bundling, local security rules, runnable TypeScript and Python examples, and inspector testing.

skills.name: agent-memory
skills.description: Design persistent memory systems for AI agents. Four-layer architecture (soul rules, learned preferences, working memory, knowledge base), memory write rules, a self-improvement loop that runs as a periodic review process, confidence levels, memory poisoning defenses, and multi-tenant scoping.

skills.name: model-distillation
skills.description: Distill a large teacher model into a small model that runs on modest hardware. Covers task scoping, training data generation, LoRA fine-tuning with unsloth, student model sizing by RAM, evaluation against the teacher, GGUF quantization, and deployment with Ollama or llama.cpp.

skills.name: rag-pipelines
skills.description: Build retrieval-augmented generation systems: document ingestion, structure-aware chunking, embeddings, vector store selection by scale, hybrid retrieval, grounded answer generation with citations, multi-tenant isolation, and evaluation of retrieval hit-rate vs answer faithfulness.

skills.name: marketing-sites
skills.description: Design and write marketing and landing pages that convert without looking AI-generated. Narrative arc, hero variations, conversion copy rules, pricing page patterns, one-memorable-element discipline, and an anti-slop blocklist for generic landing page patterns.

skills.name: dashboard-ui
skills.description: Design data-dense dashboards, admin panels, and internal tools that answer questions rather than decorate. Audience archetypes and KPI selection process, question-first hierarchy, chart selection rules, data table discipline, widget states, filters, density, and anti-patterns for dashboard design.

skills.name: mobile-app-design
skills.description: Design mobile app UIs that respect platform conventions instead of shrunken web pages. Four layers: pre-work (MFRI risk index, design bible locking), platform and navigation (iOS HIG vs Material 3, deep links, predictive back), visual design (60/30/10 color, 8-pt grid, system fonts, OLED dark mode, haptics), and execution (states, Peak-End rule, user-stage personalization, performance patterns, anti-AI-tells, 33-point quality checklist).

skills.name: cognikit
skills.description: Meta-skill that routes tasks to the right Cognikit skill and sequences multi-skill workflows. Use when a request spans fields or it is unclear which specialist applies.

skills.name: seo
skills.description: Audit and implement technical and on-page SEO to professional standard. Meta tags, canonicals, robots and sitemap rules, JSON-LD structured data, Open Graph, Core Web Vitals, EEAT signals, and anti-slop content checks.

skills.name: app-store-compliance
skills.description: Routes platform-specific store compliance tasks to Apple App Store or Google Play specialists. Use when the platform is unclear or both stores need review.

skills.name: apple-app-store-compliance
skills.description: Audit Apple-platform apps against App Review Guidelines, App Store Connect requirements, privacy and business rules; diagnose rejections and prepare factual responses. Covers guideline mapping, 2.3.10 screenshots, 3.2 distribution, and current-source verification.

skills.name: google-play-compliance
skills.description: Audit Android apps against Google Play Developer Program Policies and Play Console requirements; diagnose rejections and enforcement, reconcile Data safety, permissions, billing, ads, target API, and prepare evidence-based appeals.

skills.name: legal-docs
skills.description: Draft professional-grade privacy policies, terms of service, cookie policies, refund policies, and acceptable use documents. Intake-driven drafting matched to actual data practices with jurisdiction-aware clauses (GDPR, CCPA, COPPA).

skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.description: Author, audit, and improve Agent Skills and agent configs against the open SKILL.md standard. Covers pushy trigger descriptions, three-level progressive disclosure, execution-flow body conventions, agent frontmatter, evals.json test cases, benchmark metrics, and the validate-fix-rerun iteration loop.
